content.title: WPP Cuts Guidance Again as CEO Says Turnaround Will Take Time
content.summary: WPP  shares fell sharply after the company cut annual guidance again, with client losses hitting third-quarter results, and its new boss predicted a turnaround would take time.  In its first quarterly update since  Cindy Rose  replaced  Mark Read  as chief executive at the beginning of September, the London-based advertising and marketing-services company said a strategic review is under way with the goal of returning to growth.  The company also cut its profitability guidance, projecting a full-year headline operating profit margin of about 13%.
